podcast.title: Band Origin
podcast.body: Timbuk3 was a husband and wife duo from Madison, Wisconsin, who released a total of seven albums and several singles, though only one achieved widespread recognition. "Timbuck III was a husband and wife team from Madison, Wisconsin."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest All-Time Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders: Part 1

podcast.title: Refusal to License Song
podcast.body: The band famously declined numerous lucrative offers to license "The Future's So Bright, I Gotta Wear Shades" for commercial use, prioritizing the song's intended grim message over financial gain. "And despite offers of up to a million dollars to license the song by everyone from Ford and Bauch and Lomb and AT&T, Ray Bann sunglasses and even the US Army, they have refused any and all offers."
